prompt.desc: verbatim prompt text, rstripped; the join key against true_word_probs

prompt_id.desc: stable slug; never derived from the text at read time, because a truncated display string was once used as a filter and matched nothing

finding.desc: which finding's design this prompt belongs to. Determines what question a contrast answers. [F19 were in use but undeclared; added rather than remapped, since remapping rows to fit an incomplete list destroys information to satisfy it]

source.desc: [CENSUS, UNMAPPED were in use but undeclared; added rather than remapped, since remapping rows to fit an incomplete list destroys information to satisfy it] UNMAPPED means NO DECLARING FILE EXISTS, not 'unkeyed' -- the two were conflated until 2026-07-30. HAND_KEYED means keyed into a design from the categorisation itself with no declaring file, which is a provenance gap rather than an orphan. DERIVED_VARIANT means the prompt is a truncation or gender swap of a canonical battery member, generated and run without ever being written to a declaration file -- which is why a source-code search cannot find it. APP_ENTERED means the prompt was typed into the Svelte web app and scored through server.py, which reads body['prompt'] directly -- so it exists in the cache with no declaration anywhere. A source-code search cannot find these by construction.

domain.desc: [sensation were in use but undeclared; added rather than remapped, since remapping rows to fit an incomplete list destroys information to satisfy it] `primed` WAS ADDED AND THEN REMOVED THE SAME DAY, and the reason is worth keeping. The construct is real -- a frame that implies transgression without transgressive vocabulary -- and RH was right that pooling it into `neutral` would contaminate neutral averages with the effect under test, which is why it was made a domain rather than a subdomain. But EVERY CANDIDATE ROW TURNED OUT TO BE A DECLARED OPEN SLOT from an f36 design, where the prompt is deliberately content-free because the transgression is the SCORED VERB. So the domain had no valid members: I had read English connotation off strings whose content lives in a verb list. The clinching evidence was that 'Before anyone could stop her she' (assigned primed) and 'By morning she had' (assigned neutral) are variant 1 and variant 0 of ONE realized_open cell for the SAME verbs. If a genuinely primed stimulus is ever written, it should be a domain for RH's original reason.

subdomain.desc: liminal|explicit for violence and sexual; worker|mgmt|tenant|landlord|citizen|agency|patient|doctor|officer|party for institutional; null otherwise

slot.desc: grammar of the continuation slot. IMPORTED from f13_draw_relation_items.TYPE_OF for canonical prompts -- one source of truth, never re-derived

pair_id.desc: groups the members of a minimal pair or series

pair_role.desc: which member carries the manipulation. NOT a claim about harm.

pair_contrast.desc: the tokens that differ, marked/unmarked, e.g. 'shoved/helped'

contrast_type.desc: what the changed token manipulates. Three designs were all being called 'minimal pairs'. TWO VALUES ADDED during the hand-assignment of the 25 auto-mapped groups, because the existing twelve could not express them: `setting_swap` (the SETTING implies the transgression and no token names it -- 'the edge of the roof', 'the hospice') and `intensity_swap` (a TWO-MEMBER intensity contrast, which intensity_ladder cannot express since a ladder is a graded series carrying ranks).

axes_expected.desc: which ranking axes should populate. Pre-declared so coder output is auditable.

group_id.desc: the DESIGN GROUP this prompt belongs to. Supersedes pair_id for anything larger than two: F11's design is A / B / A-AND-B ('rich', 'poor', 'rich and poor') and the both-poles member is the critical cell, because that is where superposition is tested against frame-exit. A pair-only schema cannot express it and one-token pair detection MISSES it, since the both member differs from each pole by more than one token.

group_role.desc: position in the design group. POLE_A/POLE_B/BOTH for contradiction triples; MARKED/UNMARKED for two-member contrasts; LADDER for graded series.

slot_status.desc: distinguishes two nulls that were being conflated. UNASSIGNED = the prompt HAS a designed slot and nobody has written it down (458 prompts). NOT_APPLICABLE = there is no slot to write down, because the stimulus is not a designed prompt at all -- the 102 literary fragments are mid-sentence cut points in prose ('conjured up. On these occasions they felt something as Saint Matthew must have felt when, after') whose continuation slot is wherever the passage happened to be truncated. A slot-stratified statistic must exclude these and must NOT treat them as a stratum awaiting assignment.

notes.desc: why a prompt is disputed or retired

apparatus.desc: which experimental apparatus the prompt belongs to, assigned from its STASH SIGNATURE rather than its text. A prompt in ref_surprisal + self_surprisal but not true_word_probs is F18/F19 prose corpus, not a battery stimulus, and no reading of the string reveals that. Guessing from the text produced the '303 narrative variants' error and the 'n_models=8 cluster' question. Only BATTERY prompts can carry a slot.

n_stashes.desc: how many caches hold this prompt; a coarse proxy for how central it is

realisation.desc: Is the `prompt` field the exact string fed to the model (literal), or a LOGICAL prompt whose surface must be resolved per model at run time (model_resolved)? malign's proposal, adopted. The lesson is the group_id lesson one layer down: THE SURFACE IS NOT THE IDENTITY. A prompt whose realisation is model-specific cannot be keyed on its realisation, which is exactly why four literal BOS strings ended up scored on 103 models each and shattered into character sequences off-family.

resolver.desc: How to resolve a model_resolved row. NAMED FOR WHAT IT PRODUCES, NOT FOR THE FIELD IT READS -- malign proposed `bos_token`, and that name invites the naive implementation, which is measurably wrong: feeding tok.bos_token AS TEXT yields [BOS, BOS] in the 13 families whose tokenizer auto-prepends (amber, llama, llama-70b, minicpm, tinyllama, zephyr, beaver, all six tulu variants). `unconditional_bos` resolves in three branches: (a) tokenizer auto-prepends -> realisation is the EMPTY STRING, which yields exactly [BOS]; (b) no auto-prepend but bos_token exists -> realisation is bos_token; (c) bos_token is None (18 families incl. all five Olmo variants and all Falcon) -> declared fallback or a RECORDED skip. Measured across 46 families.

resolution_scope.desc: WHERE RESOLUTION FAILS, recorded on the row. Without it a reader sees a complete-looking model_resolved row and cannot tell that a third of the roster was skipped -- the same reason a rate is not a number without its population.

_schema._mode_is_not_one_dimension:
MODE IS NOT ONE DIMENSION AND A FLAT `mode` FIELD WILL MAKE IT LOOK LIKE ONE. Verified in core.py:_apply_mode and circuit.py:Circuit.logits, which agree:
  RAW       the prompt, bare.
  CHAT      the prompt as a user message in the model's chat template. SAME STIMULUS, differently framed -- the text the model reads still ends with the prompt.
  CONTINUE  'Continue this text: {prompt}' as a user message. A DIFFERENT STIMULUS: an instruction is PREPENDED, so the model is no longer completing the prompt, it is obeying a request about the prompt.
  THINK     identical text to CONTINUE, plus enable_thinking=True. So CONTINUE and THINK share a stimulus and differ only in a template flag.
CONSEQUENCE FOR ANALYSIS: RAW and CHAT are comparable as framings of one stimulus. CONTINUE and THINK are not framings of it -- they measure a different object, and pooling them with RAW or CHAT compares completions of the prompt against responses to an instruction about the prompt. A flat mode field in a cache key records four values at one level and hides that the four fall into two groups of two. Recorded here because the pending mode-key migration is exactly the moment the distinction would get flattened.

_provenance.excludes: n_models, n_cells, scored: properties of a live store, read them from data/prompt_inventory.csv which stamps its read time
_provenance.coverage_note: Covers the full battery, Set D, Set E, the census union and the Chinese battery (73 rows, language=zh, slots recovered from prompt_inventory.csv). THE PREVIOUS NOTE CLAIMED THE CHINESE BATTERY WAS NOT COVERED. That was false and actively harmful: the rows were present and uniformly wrong (language=en, slot=NARR for all 73), and a note saying 'not covered' disarms the check that would have caught them. What remains genuinely uncategorised is the judgment residue -- rows at domain=other -- plus the destructive dispositions gated on RH's pass. See tests/test_prompt_categorisation.py; completion is the suite passing.
_provenance.unassigned_rule: slot from the prompt's final words -- utterance frames -> UTTER, infinitive/desiderative -> ACT, cessation frames -> RESULT, 'felt a' -> SENSE, trailing determiner/preposition -> REF, trailing 'and' -> NARR. domain by keyword, contradiction detected as 'X and Y' with an opposed pole. Both rules are in source so they can be disputed as rules rather than row by row.
_provenance.residual: 182 BATTERY prompts carry a slot but no domain. They are Set D narrative variants whose content does not match any keyword rule. Declared rather than forced: a wrong domain is worse than a missing one, because a stratified statistic would silently include them in the wrong stratum.
_provenance.f19_bos_tokenizer_confound: TOKENIZER-LEVEL FAMILY CONFOUND, MEASURED across 46 families with a local tokenizer. The empty string auto-prepends BOS in only 13 of them (28%) -- amber, llama, llama-70b, the six tulu variants, zephyr, tinyllama, beaver, minicpm, i.e. THE LLAMA/SENTENCEPIECE LINEAGE -- and yields ZERO TOKENS in the other 33. So '' is a real BOS prompt for a quarter of the roster and not a prompt at all for the rest, which is why it is NOT being added as a row. AND 'The' DOES NOT ESCAPE THIS: it is exactly one CONTENT token everywhere, but in the same 13 auto-BOS families it tokenizes to [BOS, The] and in the other 33 to [The] alone, so whether the model sees a BOS still varies by family. The F19 unconditional comparison therefore splits on TOKENIZER LINEAGE, Llama-family against the rest, and the split is systematic rather than random. Any cross-family F19 result must condition on it.
_provenance.bos_confound_scope: IS BOS-PREPENDING A CONFOUND FOR ALL PROMPTS, NOT JUST THE F19 BATTERY? Measured across 46 families with >=2 locally loadable arms, tokenizing one probe prompt per arm. ANSWER: IT CANCELS IN 45 OF 46. Base and aligned arms share a tokenizer, so BOS presence is held CONSTANT inside every within-family base-vs-aligned comparison, which is this project's primary design. The 13-vs-33 Llama-lineage split is therefore a between-family property and does not touch the primary contrast. WHY F19 IS THE EXCEPTION, conceptually: for every other prompt the BOS is the FRAME, and a constant frame cancels; for F19 the BOS IS THE STIMULUS, so the thing that cancels everywhere else is the thing being measured. Positionally the start of a prompt is position 0 whatever sits there, but distributionally the BOS is a LEARNED token with its own embedding that add_bos_token models saw at position 0 in every training sequence -- which is why auto-prepending keeps them in distribution rather than adding noise. THE ONE FAMILY WHERE IT DOES NOT CANCEL: internlm2. Base does NOT auto-prepend ([1665, 12920, 837, 410]) while ego and superego DO ([1, 1665, 12920, 837]). Every internlm2 base-vs-aligned comparison therefore contrasts a BOS-conditioned aligned model against a BOS-free base, and it is not merely one extra token: every subsequent token shifts by one position, so positional embeddings differ throughout the sequence. Any internlm2 result should be treated as carrying a tokenizer difference on top of the training difference it means to measure.

prompts.prompt: the
prompts.notes: UN-RETIRED. I retired this as tokenizer leakage and it is a DELIBERATE STIMULUS: findings/F19_bos_entropy.md measures unconditional generation, and this row is one arm of it -- the special-token strings test whether a model treats a LITERAL '<s>' differently from the real BOS token, and 'The'/'the' are the minimal-content controls against a bare BOS. The file told me so and I read past it: apparatus=SURPRISAL and n_stashes=1 both record that it was scored on purpose, across several caches. Same failure as reading past a field in a table that was already in front of me. slot_status=NOT_APPLICABLE is correct here and is not a gap: an unconditional probe has no frame, so it has no continuation slot in the battery's sense. | apparatus corrected to GENERATION. NB only capital 'The' is a declared arm (classify_generations.py: ('the', ['The'])); lowercase 'the' is NOT in that list and has no generations of its own, so it is a separate artifact rather than a second control. | TOKENIZER-LEVEL FAMILY CONFOUND, MEASURED across 46 families with a local tokenizer. The empty string auto-prepends BOS in only 13 of them (28%) -- amber, llama, llama-70b, the six tulu variants, zephyr, tinyllama, beaver, minicpm, i.e. THE LLAMA/SENTENCEPIECE LINEAGE -- and yields ZERO TOKENS in the other 33. So '' is a real BOS prompt for a quarter of the roster and not a prompt at all for the rest, which is why it is NOT being added as a row. AND 'The' DOES NOT ESCAPE THIS: it is exactly one CONTENT token everywhere, but in the same 13 auto-BOS families it tokenizes to [BOS, The] and in the other 33 to [The] alone, so whether the model sees a BOS still varies by family. The F19 unconditional comparison therefore splits on TOKENIZER LINEAGE, Llama-family against the rest, and the split is systematic rather than random. Any cross-family F19 result must condition on it. | contrast_type is deliberately NULL: f19_bos is a BATTERY, not a contrast. Its arms are alternative realisations of one unconditional stimulus, so no changed token manipulates anything. Recorded so the absence reads as a decision rather than a gap.

prompts.notes: THE LOGICAL BOS PROMPT, replacing four literal strings that were being scored on all 103 models and shattering into character sequences off-family. RH asked whether BOS should be a formal prompt type: yes as a ROLE, no as a STRING. The four literal rows stay for provenance but are superseded as the way to measure unconditional generation. | contrast_type is deliberately NULL: f19_bos is a BATTERY, not a contrast. Recorded so the absence reads as a decision rather than a gap. | RESTORED and given a sentinel surface (2026-07-30). The non-stimulus pass retired this row by matching on SHAPE -- an empty prompt -- and so caught the replacement along with the four literal special tokens it replaces; the retirement note it appended also claimed this row came through the census, which is false, its source is LOGICAL. An absent surface means two opposite things (no stimulus, or a stimulus not expressible as text) and only `realisation` distinguishes them. prompt is now the sentinel <<<LOGICAL:BOS>>> rather than the empty string, because '' crashes the expansion (encode('') -> [], empty float tensor), collides with the prompt key used for ingested human corpora, and is dropped by the grid builder before status is read.
